children: WebBeds' bull at Morgans points out that the Australian travel booker would have beaten its first-half earnings guidance without the impact of an audit by Spanish tax authorities. Analyst Belinda Moore maintains a buy rating on the ASX-listed stock, telling clients in a note that--excluding the impact of the audit--WebBeds delivered earnings growth of 13%. That is a solid outcome given the impact of the Middle East conflict and adverse currency moves, she says. Moore thinks the stock has been oversold despite the prospect of an overhang from the Spanish audit. Morgans lowers its target price by 8.9% to 4.10 Australian dollars. Shares are flat at A$2.60. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
